---
title: "Single TOC in beamer output"
format:
  beamer:
    toc: true
    # render to .tex only, no PDF recipe needed
    output-ext: tex
_quarto:
  tests:
    beamer:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '\\tableofcontents'
        -
          # duplicate \tableofcontents outside the frame, removed from
          # Pandoc's beamer template in 3.11 (jgm/pandoc#11819)
          - '\\end\{frame\}\n\\setcounter\{tocdepth\}\{[0-9]+\}\n\\tableofcontents'
---
